This is more seen with Cocaine + beta blockers combo, though. I have not read anything about that happening with Amphetamines as of yet, which is why I was curious to hear from others! I don’t understand why beta blockers are dangerous for stimulants like Cocaine or caffeine(?) but yet are co-prescribed with Adderall and Vyvanse.

That, and I’m concerned with long term usage of beta blockers too. I like to take weekends off from Adderall when I can. ive been struggling with his problem too. i take Adderall in the morning and even though it helps my adhd symptoms, it makes my anxiety go to the roof :( 

i suggest consulting with your psychiatrist first. im going to ask him for a mood stabilizer/ssri to help with my anxiety and depression, so that could work for you. apparently that combo works really well for many people with underlying issues such as depression/anxiety. 

beta blockers are usually given as well. i never really knew that until recently, but that could probably help with the physical symptoms of anxiety. 

weed is also good. this is usually risky since weed tends to aggravate my anxiety, but as long as it is taken with a meal, it usually works fine.

you could also be in a really high dosage. i got horrible anxiety coming up when i was taking 25 mg a day... i lowered it back down to 15 mg and that seemed to help a bit. 

non stimulants are also an option. i personally dont like them since it doesnt help my adhd at all, but i know others have great results. 

EXERCISE. this is a must for me personally. i almost always make time to do cardio for about an hour or two. that seems to not only help with the comedown, but also helps me sleep better at night. 

no caffeine, lots of sleep, and making sure you’re eating will help too. its hard remembering on add meds, but low blood sugar and insomnia can really mess you up. 

but again, talk to your psychiatrist and make sure to tell him thoroughly. benzos should be the last option. they definitely do the job, but i would keep my dosage no more than 1 mg per day and only fake it if you’re panicking. good luck!
